integrity: The p-morphism bijection was reconstructed from the forth/back clauses and independently checked by exhaustive finite enumeration on small incidence frames. The hardness step uses the established Boolean counting dichotomy and the fact that \(\operatorname{NAE}_3\) has six tuples and hence is non-affine. The modal source was inspected at its four-point-frame decision reduction; related locally-surjective-homomorphism literature was compared for possible broader coverage.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact counting of surjective p-morphisms to one fixed four-point irreflexive Kripke frame and the explicit monotone-\(\operatorname{NAE}_3\) incidence inputs. It does not give a target dichotomy, minimal-target theorem, approximate-counting result, or uniqueness classification.
title: Counting p-morphisms onto the NAE four-point frame is \(\#\mathsf{P}\)-complete
